title: Open Local AI Panel: study protocol v1.0 and data pipeline
description: Pre-registered protocol (v1.0, frozen 2026-11-13, before the first full wave) and open-source pipeline for a monthly, reproducible panel that measures which independent local service businesses AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overview) recommend for non-branded local queries in 26 US cities across 4 niches (construction, appliance repair, roofing, cleaning); how stable those recommendations are; how they compare with Google's local pack; and how accurate the stated facts are. Data for each wave will be released as a separate dataset.
